results.reference: Allocate fixed production overhead using normal capacity. Recognize unallocated overhead as an expense in the period.
results.final:
According to Vietnamese Accounting Standard (VAS) 02, when the actual production level is below the normal capacity, fixed production overhead costs should be allocated to each unit of product based on the normal capacity level rather than the actual production volume. Any portion of these fixed production overhead costs that cannot be allocated due to the lower-than-normal production levels must be recognized as an expense in the period incurred.

This principle ensures that fixed overheads are not disproportionately burdened onto a smaller number of units produced, leading to more accurate cost allocation and financial reporting. [C2]

According to Vietnamese Accounting Standard (VAS) 02, when the quantity of inventory exceeds what is required to fulfill a non-cancellable sales contract, the net realizable value of the excess inventory should be based on the estimated selling price. This is stated in paragraph 21 of VAS 02.

Therefore, for the portion of inventory that exceeds the requirements of the non-cancellable sales contracts, the net realizable value is determined by estimating the selling prices. [C1]
